target: Obtain a parameter-free absolute dark-energy prediction from observation selection and 0D probability flow, or close the declared model class by no-go.
fixed_parent_result: DE-0D-ABSOLUTE-UNIQUE is refuted for stationary dimensionless q in local covariant EFT.

routes.changed_assumption: q is promoted from a stationary 0D parameter to q(x)
routes.current_result: A source can exist, but kinetic normalization, potential scale, matter coupling, and initial data are new inputs.
routes.reopen_when: A microscopic action derives all q-field coefficients, its dimensionful scale, and cosmological initial data.

routes.changed_assumption: local derivative expansion is replaced or supplemented by a global constraint
routes.current_result: Vacuum sensitivity may be controlled, but the four-volume, flux, boundary datum, or integration constant remains external.
routes.reopen_when: The 0D process uniquely fixes the global datum and its boundary prescription without target fitting.

routes.changed_assumption: a causal nonlocal influence functional supplies the source
routes.current_result: A mean backreaction is possible, but spectral density, IR scale, causal prescription, and initial state are not fixed by q.
routes.reopen_when: A microscopic environment derives the normalized retarded kernel, noise, Ward identity, and dimensionful scale.

routes.changed_assumption: event order and count supply spacetime volume and stochastic source
routes.current_result: Causal order fixes at most conformal structure; event density needs a length scale and a q-to-volume correlation law.
routes.reopen_when: The event process derives the discreteness scale, signed correlation law, continuum metric response, and H(z) distribution.

routes.changed_assumption: a UV theory forbids or uniquely matches the vacuum counterterm
routes.current_result: This is the only local escape from additive counterterm freedom, but no protecting symmetry or UV matching construction is supplied.
routes.reopen_when: A UV-complete model derives the hierarchy and fixes the renormalized vacuum coefficient without cosmology input.

routes.changed_assumption: dark energy is treated as an apparent distance readout rather than an absolute source
routes.current_result: A constant rendering factor cancels after calibration. Target-matching opacity needs a free n(z) and large distance-duality violation.
routes.reopen_when: A physical detector protocol derives n(z,E), passes distance duality, BAO, lensing, growth, and standard-siren controls.

next_falsifier: A predeclared physical intervention must predict a nonconstant channel-invariant distance or source response without fitting n(z), a kernel, or a vacuum coefficient.
